verdict.rationale: Aircall's developer docs include a tutorial for creating a webhook that listens to Aircall events, and a separate guide for tracking SMS activity through messaging webhooks, so developers can register outbound callbacks for both events and messages. The evidence is limited to tutorial titles. missing for 10: an explicit catalog of call event types, webhook payload, signing and retry details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, call and message events arrive as webhooks I can wire into my own systems

citations.quote: Beginner guide to create a Webhook and listen to Aircall events.
A guide to help you track Aircall SMS activity with messaging webhooks.
